name: ai.agami/agami-core
title: Agami
description: Governed semantic model for AI-to-database access. Read-only SQL with a receipt. Runs locally.

environmentVariables.name: AGAMI_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Which semantic-model profile to serve. Defaults to the one /agami-connect created.

environmentVariables.name: AGAMI_ARTIFACTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the semantic model and credentials live. Defaults to the agami artifacts directory.
